aiSummary: Dorothy lived on the vast, gray Kansas prairies with Uncle Henry and Aunt Em, in a small, sun-bleached house with no basement except a cyclone cellar accessed through a trapdoor. The sun and weather had drained joy from her surroundings and family; Aunt Em, once lively, was now thin and solemn, while Uncle Henry worked endlessly without happiness, though Toto, a playful black dog, brought Dorothy laughter. One day, ominous winds signaled a cyclone, prompting Uncle Henry to tend to the livestock and Aunt Em to warn Dorothy to seek shelter. As they hurried toward the cellar, the house violently spun and lifted into the cyclone, carrying Dorothy and Toto safely to the center where the air was calm. Initially frightened, Dorothy gradually calmed, resolved to wait calmly, and eventually lay down in her bed with Toto beside her amid the howling wind.
title: Dorothy's Cyclone Journey
